title: Optional envelope lining
owner_rule: No AI image generation of any kind (no Canva Magic Media / Dream Lab / Magic Design / text-to-image, no AI upscaling). Native vector shapes, the official Doyofy logo and pattern files, Phosphor icons (MIT) and licensed fonts only. No hand-drawn icons.

assets.prompt: Build an editable Canva design 800 × 300 px. No AI image generation of any kind (no Canva Magic Media / Dream Lab / Magic Design / text-to-image, no AI upscaling). Native vector shapes, the official Doyofy logo and pattern files, Phosphor icons (MIT) and licensed fonts only. No hand-drawn icons. Fill with ivory #F2EAD9. Upload the official file public/assets/brand/pattern-grid-gold.svg (Doyofy pattern) and tile it at 230 px cell width across the canvas, opacity 35%. Add a downward-pointing triangle mask (apex at x 400, y 300; base on the top edge) and export only the masked triangle as SVG with transparency outside the triangle. No text, no logo. This lines the envelope flap in src/features/signature/SignatureArt.tsx.
assets.avoid: AI-generated imagery, hand-drawn icons, colours outside the identity palette, text baked into art, fake data, purple/blue gradients, glassmorphism, blobs, sparkles.
assets.placement_notes: src/features/signature/SignatureArt.tsx EnvelopeBack (new <pattern> fill) — flap lining. Safe area: n/a
assets.acceptance: Visible only when the flap opens; does not compete with the card.
